source.scope: Available 2026-10-04 conversation that settled conversational decision settlement, owner reconciliation, and Matrix projection semantics.

residuals: This fixture declares available-conversation coverage only; it does not claim universal account-wide chat completeness.
The materially new canonical-before-dependent settlement rule remains owner-pending until PROGRAMSTART accepts the #205 implementation through its normal owner process.

outcomes.summary: Chat is transition evidence, not permanent runtime or execution authority.
Only accepted and current decisions being operationalized are decomposed into protected outcomes and current Matrix obligations.
Routine reconciliation should reuse existing owner, Controller, and Matrix machinery; projection cannot manufacture owner truth and replay must not duplicate consequence.

A materially new or changed accepted conversational decision must resolve to current accepted owner-native truth before dependent changed-scope consequence; owner proposal is not owner acceptance and decomposition must re-read final owner truth.
outcomes.revisit_trigger: PROGRAMSTART owner acceptance or rejection of the #205 settlement implementation.
